* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 1 February 2025<ref name="img-V0-D-knowledgeanddefense_ai">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/knowledgeanddefense_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e6e58df2da8bc676256fd425703a4c22d9dff6e8 commit e6e58df] (1 February 2025); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/knowledgeanddefense_ai.gif.</ref>. Below the words the box prints four Defensive Shield pictures in place of the first two sentences of the regular card (“Deploy on table with any number of Defensive Shields from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a card from here (as if from hand).”); only the printed words are given as game text. Text: “Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Recoil In Fear until the end of your first turn.”
